context_for_next_testing_agent: Access Control Panel testing completed successfully. All features working: 1) 5 role tabs with correct counts (User 11/31, Buyer 20/31, Dept Head 18/31, Process Eng 12/31, Capex Head 25/31). 2) Preview as Buyer shows 5 stat cards (My Assigned, Completed, In Progress, Total Purchase Value, Cost Savings). 3) Preview as Capex Head shows 4 stat cards (Budget Utilized, Pending Approvals, Cost Savings, Completion Rate). 4) Exit Preview returns to /admin. 5) Toggle item for role works (tested card_cost_savings OFF for buyer). 6) Module toggle works (disabling Dashboard hides all cards). 7) Reset to defaults works. The bug from iteration 37 (Dashboard not using effectiveRole for layout) has been FIXED.
